description: Send the person's answers and contact details to a licensed agent, who prices the quote with our carriers and contacts them (usually same business day). Only call after the person reviewed their answers and agreed to be contacted. No prices are given in chat and nothing is bound.

answers.description: Map of question id (from get_quote_questions) to the person's answer.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true: the person reviewed the answers and agreed to be contacted about the quote.

name: submit_quote_request
title: Send the quote application to a licensed agent
